objectives: The goal of this course is to introduce the fundamentals of thermal physics from a statistical perspective. The course material helps students establish core concepts in thermal physics, including entropy, temperature, the Boltzmann factor, chemical potential, and distribution functions. Ultimately, these concepts serve to bridge the macroscopic and microscopic worlds.
content:
This course will be in English only.
Although the lectures will follow the textbook, I will include additional information not covered in it. This course includes the following:
1. Microstates and Macrostates
2. Statistical distributions
3. Statistical ensembles
4. Thermal dynamical system and equilibrium
5. Thermal dynamical laws
6. Kinetic theory or Brownian motion
7. Phase transitions
books: An Introduction to Thermal Physics by Schroeder
